content.title: Reject out-of-range slot duration and capacity
content.intent: On slot entry, try outside-range duration and capacity and observe validation errors for each field.
content.technique_notes: BVA output duration [0,4,5,6,239,240,241], capacity [0,1,2,49,50,51], plus empty/null; only out-of-range values 0,4,241 and 0,51 expect the sourced error. EQP puts equal-outcome failures in one parameterized path. 3-wise risk strength=3 (auth/data-loss judged for use case); no cross-product of independent invalid fields because error co-occurrence is unspecified.
